facts.text: The estate covers 850 acres.
facts.excerpt: With 850 acres to explore

facts.text: The golf clubhouse sits at the foot of the Ochil Hills.
facts.excerpt: Guests are warmly welcomed to our clubhouse at the foot of the Ochil Hills.

facts.text: Gleneagles is about an hour from Edinburgh or Glasgow and has its own train station.
facts.excerpt: The easiest of journeys: an hour from Edinburgh or Glasgow, or arrive at our very own train station

facts.text: Gleneagles opened in 1924, commissioned by the Caledonian Railway with a railway station of its own.
facts.excerpt: Opened in rural Perthshire in 1924, commissioned by the Caledonian Railway with a railway station of its own

facts.text: The Tower Suite has three levels of Art Deco design and a private rooftop terrace.
facts.excerpt: Three levels of Art Deco grandeur – including a private rooftop terrace with unrivalled views across The Glorious Playground.

facts.text: Rooms are individually inspired by the mountains, meadows, rivers and lakes of the Perthshire countryside.
facts.excerpt: All individually inspired by the mountains and meadows, rivers and lakes of the Perthshire countryside.

facts.text: The signature suite is the Royal Lochnagar.
facts.excerpt: From our signature suite – the Royal Lochnagar – and our most glamorous residence – The Tower Suite

facts.text: Glenmor lodges offer self-catering facilities and space for the whole family.
facts.excerpt: Blending the luxury and adventure of our Glorious Playground with self-catering facilities and space for the whole family, Glenmor offers the best of both worlds.

facts.text: Andrew Fairlie is a two-Michelin-starred restaurant serving French-inspired cooking.
facts.excerpt: This intimate two-Michelin-starred gastronomic delight is renowned for simple yet indulgent French-inspired cooking and exemplary service.

facts.text: The Strathearn serves modern Scottish dishes by candlelight with traditional gueridon service and a grand piano.
facts.excerpt: Expect theatre from the traditional gueridon service, melodic notes from the grand piano and exceptional modern Scottish dishes from some of the best chefs in the country, all served by candlelight.

facts.text: The Birnam has an Italian-leaning menu of handmade pasta and steaks cooked over open flame.
facts.excerpt: The Italian-leaning menu majors in handmade pasta, steaks cooked over open flame, and tableside specials like the now-famous chicken Caesar salad.

facts.text: The American Bar is a 1920s cocktail lounge.
facts.excerpt: the opulent surroundings of our very own 1920s cocktail lounge

facts.text: The Century Bar has 400 whiskies.
facts.excerpt: With 400 whiskies, a carefully curated wine list and endless expertly made cocktails

facts.text: The Garden Cafe is dog-friendly.
facts.excerpt: It’s dog-friendly too, with plenty of space in the atrium to bring your four-legged friend.

facts.text: A kitchen garden inspires ingredients used in the menus, cocktails and spa therapies.
facts.excerpt: our beautiful kitchen garden is the inspiration behind many of the ingredients you’ll find on our menus, in our cocktails and even in our spa therapies.

facts.text: Gym and Swim facilities include two indoor pools, an outdoor thermal pool and a gym.
facts.excerpt: With two indoor pools, an outdoor thermal pool, a state-of-the-art gym and 850 acres of Glorious Playground

facts.text: The spa uses Gleneagles oil blends with natural botanicals from the Perthshire countryside.
facts.excerpt: a range of Gleneagles oil blends featuring natural botanicals from the Perthshire countryside

facts.text: The leisure facilities include an adults-only thermal suite.
facts.excerpt: explore our adults-only thermal suite

facts.text: Gleneagles has three championship golf courses and one 9-hole course.
facts.excerpt: Three championship golf courses and one 9-hole course

facts.text: The King's Course was designed by James Braid.
facts.excerpt: Designed by the legendary James Braid, the heather and heathland based King’s has enthralled golfers

facts.text: The PGA Centenary Course was created by Jack Nicklaus.
facts.excerpt: Created by 18-time major winner, Jack Nicklaus

facts.text: Gleneagles hosted the Ryder Cup in 2014.
facts.excerpt: The Ryder Cup is played from 26-28 September, the biggest team event in golf

facts.text: Gleneagles hosted the Solheim Cup in 2019.
facts.excerpt: The Solheim Cup is played from 13-15 September, and is the highest attended women’s golf event ever held in the UK.

facts.text: Gleneagles is home to the PGA National Academy for Scotland.
facts.excerpt: Home to the PGA National Academy for Scotland

facts.text: Country pursuits include fishing on the River Tay and hawking in the hills.
facts.excerpt: From fishing on the River Tay to hawking in the hills

facts.text: Pursuits include a shooting and fishing school, off-road driving, gundogs and falconry, and an equestrian school.
facts.excerpt: The Shooting & Fishing School

facts.text: The Sporting Club has 8 tennis courts and three padel courts.
facts.excerpt: with 8 tennis courts and three padel courts

facts.text: The Sporting Club has an indoor climbing and bouldering wall.
facts.excerpt: Gleneagles Sporting Club is also home to our 7m high and 27m wide indoor climbing and bouldering wall.

facts.text: The Equestrian School offers lessons for guests from age four up.
facts.excerpt: We offer indoor and outdoor coaching, horse riding lessons and horse walking tours for guests at all levels, from age four up.

facts.text: Little Glen Adventurers is a programme for 3-7 year olds.
facts.excerpt: Discover Gleneagles for 3-7 year olds, where adventure is around every corner.

facts.text: The Den Adventurers is tailored for 8-12 year olds.
facts.excerpt: Step into a world of outdoor adventure tailored for 8-12 year olds.

facts.text: Whisky tastings with the Senior Whisky Ambassador are held in The Still Room.
facts.excerpt: This masterclass offers a sensory exploration of five distinctive pours, guided by our Senior Whisky Ambassador.

facts.text: In Braid House, all rooms except those on the ground floor have balconies with estate views.
facts.excerpt: in the newer wing, Braid House (where all rooms except on the ground floor have balconies with estate views)

facts.text: All accessible rooms are in the Braid House wing.
facts.excerpt: All of the hotel’s accessible rooms are located within the Braid House wing of the hotel

facts.text: Between January and March, The Winter Lodge opens.
facts.excerpt: Between January and March, The Winter Lodge opens its doors

facts.text: Golf courses close from time to time for essential maintenance.
facts.excerpt: In order to enhance the quality of our courses it is necessary for us to close them from time to time to carry out essential maintenance.

facts.text: The golf resort is open to golfers of all abilities all year round and does not ask for a handicap certificate.
facts.excerpt: Gleneagles golf resort is open to golfers of all abilities, all-year round and we don’t ask for a handicap certificate.

facts.text: Rooms have been made over by the interiors studio Goddard Littlefair.
facts.excerpt: Rooms exude a smart country warmth and have been made over by Goddard Littlefair

facts.text: Bob & Cloche is the beauty lodge.
facts.excerpt: Here you’ll also find our Swim & Gym spaces and beauty lodge, Bob & Cloche.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of Scotland's most iconic luxury hotels.
facts.excerpt: Gleneagles is one of Scotland’s most iconic luxury hotels
